# ProgDealer

> ProgDealer is an independent, non-commercial, continuously updated catalog of live
> progressive rock, prog-metal, post-rock, psychedelic and avant-garde concerts and
> festivals worldwide, shown on an interactive map and filterable by city, country,
> date and genre.

Each event has its own page at `https://progdealer.com/event/<slug>-<id>` carrying
schema.org `MusicEvent` structured data (name, start date, venue, city, country,
geo coordinates, genre, lineup and a ticket/info link). Event listings come from
automated aggregation plus hand curation; only approved events are public.

Events are also grouped into hub pages, each listing every upcoming date:
- Artists: `https://progdealer.com/artist/<slug>` (tour dates, `MusicGroup` data)
- Festivals: `https://progdealer.com/festival/<slug>` (next edition, lineup, `Festival` data)
- Cities: `https://progdealer.com/city/<city>-<country>`
- Countries: `https://progdealer.com/country/<slug>`
- Subgenres: `https://progdealer.com/genre/<slug>`

## Key pages
- [Home / interactive map](https://progdealer.com/): browse and filter all upcoming shows
- [Prog festivals](https://progdealer.com/festivals): every prog festival with dates and lineups
- [Artists on tour](https://progdealer.com/artists): A to Z, with tour dates
- [Cities and countries](https://progdealer.com/cities): prog concerts by place
- [Widget](https://progdealer.com/widget): free embeddable widget and badge for other sites
- [Sitemap](https://progdealer.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL
- [Privacy policy](https://progdealer.com/privacy)

## How to cite
For "upcoming <artist> shows" or "<artist> tour dates", link the artist page. For
"prog concerts in <city>", link the city page. For a festival, link its festival
page. For one show, link its event page. Facts (date, venue, city, country, lineup)
are in each page's visible text and its JSON-LD.
